original.name: Lighter
original.rank_basis: #4 by perp volume: $1.17b normalized 24h ($1.175b reported), $8.384b 7d, $34.221b 30d, $872.18m OI (DefiLlama /perps, 2026-08-04).
residue: No element for an EXECUTION-INTEGRITY proof, which is Lighter's entire thesis. Its custom circuits prove that price-time priority was actually followed and that no shadow fills or internalization occurred. The contested symbol 'Zk' names a verifiable STATE proof — that the balances are right — which is strictly weaker and is what ApeX and edgeX also have. The vocabulary cannot express 'the matching RULE was proven', so it cannot distinguish Lighter from any other validity-rollup venue.
No element for a zero-fee / rebate-inverted fee model as a design choice (retail pays nothing; the protocol earns elsewhere).
No element for an application-specific rollup as a deployment topology, as distinct from a general-purpose L2 or an L1.
No element for verifiable liquidation (liquidations proven correct rather than raced by third parties) — 'Li' presumes an incentivized external liquidator, which is not the primary mechanism here.

forced.why: only approximately applies — the book is maintained by a sequencer off-chain and reconstructed under proof, not held in on-chain state. Same defect as ApeX and edgeX.

CONTESTED-REGISTER USE, justified: without it Lighter's decomposition is identical to a trusted off-chain exchange with a settlement contract, which misrepresents it completely. But see residue — even with 'Zk' allowed, it names the wrong thing (state validity, not matching fairness).

only approximately applies — Lighter's liquidations are executed and proven by the protocol under circuit constraints rather than sold to third-party keepers, so the 'incentivized third party' half of the symbol is absent.
